dimensions.issue_validity: Legitimate bug filed by the repository owner with clear root cause analysis. The sous-chef agent misinterprets parent-child dependency metadata from bd show as real blockers, causing false BLOCKED verdicts.
dimensions.actionability: Highly actionable. The Kiro sous-chef prompt instructs running bd show for context but provides no guidance on distinguishing parent-child (structural grouping) from blocks (execution-order constraints) dependency types. Fix scope: update sous-chef prompt or filter dependency info before passing to reviewer.
dimensions.project_relevance: Directly relevant to core functionality. Involves serve phase signal detection in phase.py, BLOCKED handling in iteration.py, and circuit breaker in loop.py.
dimensions.priority_signal: High priority. Makes the entire autonomous loop non-functional for the Kiro CLI backend. Every task returns BLOCKED regardless of actual dependency state, and the circuit breaker trips after 5 consecutive failures.
dimensions.duplicate_check: No duplicate found among open issues.

rationale: Well-investigated, high-impact bug with a clear root cause. The sous-chef agent runs bd show and encounters parent-child dependency metadata which it misinterprets as real blockers. This produces a BLOCKED verdict that propagates through signal detection and trips the circuit breaker. The fix is scoped to the sous-chef prompt templates where dependency types need to be distinguished or filtered.
